component_semantics.L_form: six-class cross entropy; optional frozen TRAIN-derived class weight applies only here
component_semantics.L_scenario_count: cross entropy over 0..S_MAX; canonical complex scenario count and zero for non-complex forms
component_semantics.L_scenario_activity: BCE over S_MAX queries after hierarchical matching; matched queries one, unmatched queries zero
component_semantics.L_slot_count: cross entropy over 0..L_MAX for matched active scenario queries only
component_semantics.L_slot_activity: BCE over L_MAX slot queries within each matched active scenario
component_semantics.L_assignment: candidate-membership BCE over K for matched applicable slots; zero-valid slots masked
component_semantics.L_flat_set: candidate-membership BCE over K for simple mappable forms only; complex forms do not use it

hierarchical_match.order: called before scenario/slot/assignment structural targets are constructed
hierarchical_match.cost_inputs: detached scenario and slot activity logits; matching is discrete and supervision remains differentiable

normalization: candidate membership within slot, slots within scenario, applicable structural terms within source; equal arithmetic mean of applicable component scalars per source; mean source totals across batch
non_applicable: omitted from source denominator and component denominator; represented as null when no source is applicable
assignment_masking: skip a required slot when no gold alternative is present in the frozen candidate universe
